summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated wrapper (hex-mangled `_0xXXXX` identifiers, control-flow object literals) that, when Bun is not already present, downloads a Bun runtime archive from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/...`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the bundled sibling file `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation and hex-mangled symbol names; its behavior cannot be reconciled with the declared purpose of the package (a small Babel AST transform of roughly 90 lines in `lib/index.js`). The unscoped name `babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined` mimics the legitimate scoped upstream `@ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined` — the `package.json` author and repository fields point at the Ornikar upstream while the malicious preinstall and Bun-executed payload are not present in the legitimate package. The pattern — fetching an alternate language runtime at install time to execute an opaque obfuscated bundled payload — is designed to defeat Node-based supply-chain scanners once execution transitions into Bun.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
